notes.title: Version 0.727 Emergency Patch
notes.notes:
1. Add 12 small celestial bodies to enrich the map; some small celestial bodies will drop corresponding items when destroyed; some small celestial bodies will only appear in specific types of areas.
2. Most insect modules can operate without being controlled by a mothership; the acid range of the Ambushing Beetle is increased by 100%; the energy burst requirement for the Energy-sucking Beetle is reduced by 20%; the explosion range of the Suicide Bee is increased by 100%; the maximum attack range of the Electric Bug is increased by 33%.
3. Optimize the nebulae and stars in the background to reduce resource consumption; reduce the brightness inside stars.
4. Increase the collection probability of some item props and fix the issue of no collection bonus in the Decayed Insect Domain.
5. Press and hold the right mouse button in the ship editing interface to display more ship module information; currently, only some modules will be displayed; changes in in-game currency when entering ship editing in Long-haul mode will be settled uniformly after exiting the interface; fix the issue that may replace a player's ship with a test ship; fix the issue of unidentified modules.
6. Add 2 types of reconnaissance modules, one prioritizing locking onto ships and the other prioritizing small targets; no longer lock onto objects beyond the attack range.
7. Modify the calculation method of area damage, making it easier to detect and calculate area damage, but the overall limit is changed to base damage × 2. Correct the base damage and range of ship energy module detonation.
8. Reduce the base damage bonus of area damage weapons by 20-30% for the Enlargement module.
9. Thunder modules will cause additional damage to exposed ship hulls.
10. Fix the issue of being unable to engage in long-distance navigation.
11. When entering the backpack or store, continuous clicking can be used for continuous purchase, use, sell, or discard; fix the issue of a purchase option for items with a quantity of 0 appearing in the store.

notes.title: Ver0.726 Patch Update
notes.notes:
1. Increased the coordinate display on the large map, with the button response time on the large map reduced to 0.25 seconds.
2. Increased the refresh rate of the small celestial bodies and ships on the map by 60%.
3. Optimized the planet generation function in the star system, initially generating images of 256×256, and later generating standard images of 2048×2048 after some time to display faster on the map.
4. When piloting a ship, the current ship status will be displayed in the upper right corner.
5. Reduced the refresh rate of unmanned planets by 50%.
6. Added 2 neutral factions.
7. Expanded the capacity of the ESC main menu and optimized some operations in the main menu.
8. Planets will no longer have docking functions; when approaching, they will automatically connect to the planet channel and allow negotiation. Negotiations will no longer change the field of view, and hostile planets will also allow free trade and ship assembly. The increase in friendliness gained when purchasing supplies from a faction has been enhanced.
9. Added a UI icon for the activation of the hyper-pulse engine.
10. Added permanent space stations; two space stations will automatically refresh when players enter each celestial system.
11. Optimized AI command in battle mode, making it more proactive in occupying unmanned fortresses and optimizing ship AI routes.
12. The ship purchase interface now allows mouse-click operations.
13. Fixed a bug that allowed unlimited harvesting during certain time periods.
14. Added interactive effects triggered subsequently by the impact beam module and the lightning beam module.

notes.title: Demo Update 1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840719/25e8f9e00f8dbd735e497e5a5408828aafcaf40c.gif
Update：
1.Optimize the collision system of the game and increase the frame rate stability system during battles. When the game stutters, the game will automatically slow down to stabilize the frame rate (try to stabilize it at 24 frames or more)

2.Optimize the inheritance function of the weapon system, as shown in the figure, to continue generating multiple segments of laser after the laser forks.

3.Add 4 modules for weapon systems, 1 gain type module, and 3 directional connection modules.

Gain type module - Target pointing module: can make bullets actively face the current target position (aiming position).


Directional connection module: It can make the module connection more directional, without the need to connect in all four directions as before. The module can be connected in two directions up and down, two directions up and right, and three directions up, down and right. The editing of weapon systems has become more flexible.


4.Add a simple tutorial feature to the spacecraft editing system.

This update is temporarily over, and a new mode will be updated next. Stay tuned.
If you have any good suggestions, please email them to 1317193145@qq.com I will carefully review and make the necessary modifications. Thank you.
Due to the fact that the game is only created by me, the updates are relatively slow. Please forgive me.
